summary: Configure one base timer and provide a non-blocking periodic-dispatch module.
requires: A validated board profile whose MCU matches the new project and has a cited timing constraint for a requested period.
The selected MCU's local CubeMX timer mode/configuration XML for the exact base-timer mode, prescaler, period, and interrupt setting.
A named HAL_TIM_PeriodElapsedCallback owner that routes periodic dispatch for the project.
verifications: Verify generated main.c initializes the intended timer with the approved prescaler and period.
Verify the CubeMX interrupt source and NVIC setting are present before adding an application callback route.
Compile the project after module integration.
